title: Extraction and Measurement of Polyphosphate and Inorganic Phosphorus from Microalgae Samples
author: Yingyu Hu

steps_raw.title: Sample collection
steps_raw.instruction: Filter microalgae in liquid media onto GF/F or PC filters, using gentle vacuum pressure (130 mmHg). Filter forceps (blunt end, stainless steel, Millipore, XX6200006P)

steps_raw.title: Sample collection
steps_raw.instruction: Rinse sample with filtered saline (no nutrients)

steps_raw.title: Sample collection
steps_raw.instruction: Place sample filters in cryogenic vials

steps_raw.title: Sample collection
steps_raw.instruction: Filter same volume of the blank media (without cells) through GF/F or PC filter as blank.

steps_raw.title: Sample collection
steps_raw.instruction: Flash freeze filters and stored at -80 °C

steps_raw.title: Sample collection
steps_raw.instruction: Freeze dry before measurement. FreeZone® 2.5 L Benchtop Freeze Dryers (Labconco®, 700202000)

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: Tris buffer 20 mM pH 7.0 Budget: About 250 mL per four samples

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: In a 1 L volumetric flask, top 20 mL 1 M pH 7.0 Tris buffer to 1 L with MilliQ

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: Store at Room temperature

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: PolyP primary standard stock

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: Weigh one glass pellet of polyP (45) and write down the weight. Microbalance (Cubis series, Sartorius, MSE6.6S-000-DM)

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer the pellet into a 100 mL graduated cylinder.

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: Dilute to 100 mL with Tris 20 mM pH 7.0

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: Aliquot primary stock into 10~50 uL per microtube with Stepper and store at -20 °C

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: PolyP secondary standard stock If the pellet is far more than 10 mg, dilute primary to secondary to bring down the concentration before preparing working standard

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: Proteinase K 20 mg/ml

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: Add 25 mL MilliQ directly into the original package of Proteinase K, vortex to mix

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: Aliquot 700 uL to microtubes and keep frozen at -20 °C

steps_raw.title: Preparation of reagents
steps_raw.instruction: DAPI primary stock 14.3 mM Add 2 mL MilliQ directly into the original package and keep frozen at -20 °C

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Prepare boiling bath. VWR® Advanced Hot Plates (VWR, 97042-658) Hollow Polypropylene (PP) Ball Bath Covers, 20 mm (Cole-Parmer, UZ-06821-04) Tube rack (Simport MultiRack™, CA48648-606)

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer sample into glass centrifuge tube Disposable Glass Screw-Cap Centrifuge Tubes (10 mL, Corning®, 99502-10)

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Add 4 mL Tris buffer 20 mM pH 7.0 , vortex and then sonicate. Specific Pipette Tips 5mL (Thermo Scientific™ Finntip™, 21-377-304)

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Keep in boiling bath. Make sure the tube rack is in the middle of the boiling bath and covered with PP balls. Tris solution in the tube should be boiling during the 5 minutes' incubation.

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Sonicate

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Vortex and then transfer extract to 15 mL Falcon tube, according to the extract number. Do not push filter to the bottom. Use Pasteur pipet, gently lift the filter upwards, and then transfer as much extract as possible. Gently press the extract out of the filter. Disposable Soda-Lime Glass Pasteur Pipets (5 3/4", Fisherbrand, 13-678-6A)

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Repeat Step 17 to Step 20 until complete 15 times' extraction in total.

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Use forward pipetting, load black microtitre plate with 200 µL supernatant from the extract (one well for one extract, no need to load replicates). Tris buffer 20 mM pH 7.0 is used as blank. 96-Well Black Microplates (Polystyrene, Greiner Bio-One, 655076)

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Prepare DAPI working solution 100 uM Dilute 12.6 µL of 14.3 mM DAPI stock with 1800 µL MilliQ in a foil wrapped microtube and vortex.

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: In the dimmed room with only red light bulb on add 24 µL 100 uM DAPI to each sample in the plate.

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Adhere black film on the top of a microplate lid and cover the plate with this lid. Black Vinyl Films for Fluorescence and Photoprotection (VWR, 89087-692)

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Shake at room temperature for 00:07:00

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Read fluorescence: excitation at 410 nm and emission at 550 nm Varioskan LUX Multimode Microplate Reader (Thermo Fisher, VL0L00D0)

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Plot fluorescence intensity versus number of extraction. The number of extract (N) is the stationary point where the fluorescence of stained extract stops decreasing or the derivative of the fluorescence after that point is close to zero. If RFU(15)-RFU(Tris)>1 , proceed to extract five additional times. And then measure the stained extract following the previous steps.

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated extract
steps_raw.instruction: Well mix 1~N extract, transfer 12 mL into 15 mL falcon tube, centrifuge 3200 rpm, Room temperature, 5 minutes

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated extract
steps_raw.instruction: In Set S, add 18 µL RNase and 18 µL DNase RNase tends to leave residue in the tip. However one package has only 1 mL RNase, it will be a waste to use reverse pipetting. After dispensing RNase into the vial, use the same tip to draw the solution and gently dispense it back into the solution for about three time, so that there is no residue remaining in the tip. Replace a new tip for the next vial. Require ~400 uL RNase and ~400 uL DNase.

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated extract
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C , shake continuously SHAKING INCUBATOR (71L, Corning® LSE™, 6753) Start the timer when temperature reaches 37 °C

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated extract
steps_raw.instruction: In Set S, add 36 µL Proteinase

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated extract
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C , shake continuously. Start the timer when temperature reaches 37 °C

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated standard amended extract
steps_raw.instruction: Prepare DAPI working solution 100 uM Dilute 12.6 µL of 14.3 mM DAPI stock with 1800 µL MilliQ in a foil wrapped microtube and vortex.

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated standard amended extract
steps_raw.instruction: Prepare PolyP working standard [PO3]~ 7.6 uM Based on the actual concentration of PolyP (45) primary or secondary standard stock, dilute a certain volume of stock with Tris buffer 20 mM pH 7.0 For a final concentration 7.6 uM Total volume = 160 X N (ul), where N = sample number FW(45Na2O.55P2O5)=10600 Mol of PO3 per mol of PolyP (45) = 110

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated standard amended extract
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer 840 µL of enzyme treated extract (1~N) into 2 mL tubes (Set A). Forward pipetting, aspire and dispense for three times to mix.

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated standard amended extract
steps_raw.instruction: Add 160 µL 7.6 uM polyP working standard to 840 µL of enzyme treated extract, vortex.

steps_raw.title: Load microtiter plate
steps_raw.instruction: Load 200 µL blanks (B: N+1), samples (S: 1~N) and amended samples (A: Amended 1~N) to the microplate. Organize samples as shown in the following scheme: Reverse pipetting

steps_raw.title: Load microtiter plate
steps_raw.instruction: In a dimmed room with only red bulb on, add 24 µL DAPI working solution 100 uM to each sample in the microplate except for those labelled with (UN) . Forward pipetting

steps_raw.title: Load microtiter plate
steps_raw.instruction: Adhere black film on the top of a microplate lid and cover the plate with this lid.

steps_raw.title: Load microtiter plate
steps_raw.instruction: Shake at room temperature for 00:07:00

steps_raw.title: Load microtiter plate
steps_raw.instruction: Shake duration: 1 min Shaking type: continuous Shaking speed and force: 600 rpm/High Fluorescence: excitation at 410 nm and emission at 550 nm Measurement time: 300 ms Excitation bandwidth: 5 nm

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Centrifuge the extract 3200 rpm, Room temperature, 5 minutes

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated extract
steps_raw.instruction: Centrifuge extract "N+1" 3200 rpm, Room temperature, 5 minutes Blank is duplicated into B1a and B1b; B2a and B2b... etc.

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated extract
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer 1.8 mL supernatant to a 2 mL tube (Set S). Sample is triplicated into S1a, S1b and S1c; S2a, S2b, S2c...etc.

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated extract
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer 1.5 mL supernatant into a 2 mL tube (Set B).

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated extract
steps_raw.instruction: In Set B, add 15 µL RNase and 15 µL DNase

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated extract
steps_raw.instruction: Thaw proteinase (~700uL)

steps_raw.title: Enzyme treated extract
steps_raw.instruction: In Set B, add 30 µL Proteinase
Calculation
Calculation

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Combine Extraction 1 to Extraction N into a falcon tube. Try to transfer all solution including debris from each tube. If the total volume is over 50 mL, use a beaker instead. Sample code N V(Tris) per extract (mL) 1 2 3 4

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Label centrifuge tube for different samples, place one Pasteur pipet into the tube for transferring extract from the same sample

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Label 15 mL Falcon tube from 1 to 15 for each one sample.

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Prepare 37 °C incubator/shaker.
Preliminary extraction efficiency test

steps_raw.title: Preliminary extraction efficiency test
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer 500 µL supernatant to a 2 mL microtube for Inorganic P measurement. Label each tube as 1-1, 1-2, ..., 1-N 2-1, 2-2, ..., 2-N 3-1, 3-2, ..., 3-N 4-1, 4-2, ..., 4-N

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: KH 2 PO 4 primary standard stock solution (≈ 1 mM) Potassium dihydrogen orthophosphate ACP Chemicals Catalog #P-4550 (CAS: 7778-77-0)

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer about 1 g KH 2 PO 4 into a beaker, cover the beaker with foil

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Place the beaker into an oven, dry KH 2 PO 4 at 110 °C for at least 02:00:00

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Move KH 2 PO 4 into a vacuum desiccator, allow KH 2 PO 4 to cool to room temperature

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Dissolve around 0.136 g dried KH 2 PO 4 in 1 L milliQ water. Use 1 L volumetric flask Take notes of the actual weight of KH 2 PO 4 for final concentration of standard stock solution

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer standard stock solution into a 1 L bottle and store in the fridge. This stock solution lasts quite a long time, unless there is evidence for growth of algae or other extraneous biotic material.

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Standard working solution KH2PO4 Primary (uL) MilliQ (uL) 1 S1 0 1000 2 S2 5 995 3 S3 10 990 4 S4 20 980 5 S5 50 950 6 S6 100 900 7 S7 150 850 8 S8 200 800

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer 500 uL of each standard working solution to 2 mL microtube.

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Remove extract from the fridge and warm up to room temperature.

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: 2.5 % ammonium molybdate reagent: Weigh 0.25 g ammonium molybdate in a Falcon tube and top to 10 g with MilliQ water. Cap and shake until totally dissolved. Ammonium molybdate Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #09878-100G (CAS: 12054-85-2)

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: 10 % ascorbic acid reagent: Weigh 1 g ascorbic acid in a Falcon tube and top to 10 g with MilliQ water; Cap and shake until all dissolved. Ascorbic acid Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #A5960-100G (CAS: 50-81-7)

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: 6 N (3 M) sulfuric acid reagent: Carefully add 1 part 18 M concentrated sulfuric acid into 5 part MilliQ water Save the pipet tip for final reagent preparation.

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Calculate the volume of molybdate-ascorbic reagent: Total volume of reagent_mL = (0.5 mL) X (#standard working solution + #samples + #blanks)

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Mix the reagents into Falcon tube: Reagent Parts in volume 1 MilliQ 2 2 6N sulphuric acid 1 3 2.5% ammonium molybdate 1 4 10% ascorbic acid 1

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Preheat incubator/shaker to 37 °C

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Add 500 µL reagent to each standard, sample and blank, starting from blanks, including blank for standards and blank for samples. Finntip Stepper Tips (5 mL, Thermo Scientific, 9404200) Before dispensing the reagent, wipe or dab the liquid drop on the outside of the tip, avoid wiping the open tip.

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Vortex each tube

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for 03:00:00 while shaking at 200 rpm

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Load microplate with 250 uL reactant from each tube, duplicate. Example of loading the microplate

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Read plate in microplate reader A B 1 Shake duration 00:00:05 2 Shaking type Continuous 3 Shaking force High 4 Shaking speed [rpm] 600 5 Wavelength [nm] 820 6 Use transmittance No 7 Pathlength correction No 8 Measurement Time [ms] 100

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Calculation

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Subtract the average absorbance at 820 nm of the blank standard replicates from the absorbance at 820 nm of all other standard working solutions.

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Subtract the average absorbance at 820 nm of the blank sample (i.e. blank filter) replicates from the absorbance at 820 nm of all other individual samples.

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Prepare a standard curve by plotting the average blank-corrected 820 nm absorbance for each standard working solution versus its concentration in uM.

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: Use the standard curve to determine the orthophosphate concentration of each unknown sample by using its blank-corrected 820 nm absorbance.

steps_raw.title: Inorganic P measurement
steps_raw.instruction: 22.5% polyP can be measured by molybdate assay, possibly due to the partial hydrolysis in acid condition Where, Pi umol is the concentration of inorganic P, Pj uM is inorganic P from each extract, Vj is the volume of Tris, n is the total extraction times, polyP umol is the polyP concentration in the sample.
